name: bgg-bench-pdfs
description: A dataset of PDF documents intended to measure models' ability to read, parse, and extract structured information from long-form game-related PDFs. The benchmark evaluates document understanding tasks such as document-level question answering and information extraction from scanned or native PDFs. It stresses robustness to varied layouts, tables, and domain-specific terminology found in board‑game manuals and related materials.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face focused on document understanding in a specific domain; modest adoption outside its target community.
